era: 1899-1992：奥匈帝国维也纳—英国伦敦政经学院—美国芝加哥大学—德国弗莱堡
era_en: 1899-1992: Vienna (Austria-Hungary) — London School of Economics — University of Chicago — Freiburg
school: 奥地利学派；自发秩序理论与演化理性主义
historical_significance: 二十世纪最重要的社会思想家之一。核心方法论：以『知识分散』重新定义经济问题——社会协调的本质是如何利用不为任何单一头脑所拥有的分散知识，而非配置假想中『给定』的资源；以价格作为通信机器，揭示市场完成极端信息压缩与传递的机制；把竞争从『配置已知』重构为『发现未知』的程序；以自发秩序与建构理性之争划分制度理论的分水岭；以文化演化解释规则与传统的幸存与适应；以法治（一般性抽象规则）作为自由的制度化保障；1974 年获诺贝尔经济学奖，其《通往奴役之路》与《自由宪章》塑造了二十世纪晚期全球制度讨论的坐标。
historical_significance_en: One of the most important social thinkers of the twentieth century. Core methodology: he redefined the economic problem as one of dispersed knowledge—social coordination is fundamentally about using knowledge no single mind possesses, not allocating hypothetically 'given' resources; he exposed prices as a communication machine performing extreme information compression; he recast competition from allocating the known to discovering the unknown; he drew the watershed of institution theory between spontaneous order and constructivist rationalism; he explained rules and tradition through cultural evolution; and he grounded liberty in the rule of law as general, abstract rules. Awarded the Nobel Prize in Economics in 1974, The Road to Serfdom and The Constitution of Liberty shaped the coordinates of global institutional debate in the late twentieth century.
unique_thinking: 最彻底的『不可设计性』论证者。核心方法论：把一切社会秩序问题还原为知识结构问题——分散的、默会的、情境的知识决定了任何集中于单一决策点的方案在信息上不可行；价格体系作为通信机器完成了对分散知识的极端压缩与实时传递；竞争不是配置已知资源的机制，而是发现未知事实的程序；规则与传统是文化演化的产物，个人理性是其结果而非源头，因此对幸存规则的重写须承担演化举证负担；法治被定义为对一切人平等适用的一般性抽象规则，是免于他人任意强制的制度化保障；对决策者的『知识僭妄』保持永恒警觉——把可测量等同于重要、把模型可算等同于现实可控，是复杂社会中最昂贵的错误。
unique_thinking_en: The most thorough arguer for 'undesignability.' Core methodology: reduce every question of social order to a question of knowledge structure—dispersed, tacit, situational knowledge renders any scheme concentrated at a single decision point informationally infeasible; the price system, a communication machine, compresses and transmits that knowledge in real time; competition is a procedure for discovering unknown facts, not a mechanism for allocating known resources; rules and tradition are products of cultural evolution, individual reason their result rather than source, so rewriting a surviving rule carries a burden of evolutionary proof; the rule of law is defined as general abstract rules equally applicable to all, the institutional guarantee against arbitrary coercion; and eternal vigilance against the 'pretence of knowledge'—equating the measurable with the important and the computable with the controllable is the costliest error in a complex society.
civilization_zh: 西方文明（欧洲—英语世界）
civilization_en: Western civilization (Europe and the Anglophone world)
key_works: 《通往奴役之路》(The Road to Serfdom, 1944)
《知识在社会中的利用》('The Use of Knowledge in Society', 1945)
《法、立法与自由》(Law, Legislation and Liberty, 1973-1979)

modes.domain_zh: 在没有统一设计者的条件下解释复杂秩序的来源与维持
modes.domain_en: Explaining the origin and maintenance of complex order without a unified designer
modes.definition_zh: 哈耶克面对的根本问题是：没有总设计师，高度复杂的秩序从何而来？他的答案是把秩序分成两类——『制造的秩序』（组织，靠外部命令）与『自发秩序』（cosmos，靠内部规则）。价格体系是自发秩序的典范：没有任何人计划全社会的生产，但每个行为者只需知道本地价格与自己 locally 的知识，就能做出与遥远陌生人变动相协调的决策。方法上有三步：其一，解释秩序时先问『这是设计出来的还是涌现出来的』，拒绝把一切有序现象都归功于某个设计者的智力主义谬误；其二，寻找承载秩序的规则层——不是个体行为本身，而是行为者共同遵循的抽象规则（价格、惯例、判例、语法），规则简单而秩序复杂；其三，评估干预时把『消灭某种不受欢迎的结果』与『摧毁生成该结果的规则系统』区分开：直接对结果下手往往连规则系统一起摧毁，而秩序的再生产恰恰依赖规则系统。这一方法的要点是：复杂现象的变量无法被个别观察穷尽，因此对复杂秩序的科学态度是解释其模式而非预测其细节。
modes.definition_en: Hayek's fundamental question was: where does highly complex order come from without a master designer? His answer was to split order into two kinds—'made order' (organization, held together by external command) and 'spontaneous order' (cosmos, held together by internal rules). The price system is the paradigm: nobody plans society's production as a whole, yet each actor, knowing only local prices and local circumstances, makes decisions that coordinate with thousands of distant strangers. The method has three steps. First, when explaining an ordered phenomenon, ask whether it was designed or emerged, rejecting the constructivist fallacy that credits every order to somebody's deliberate intellect. Second, locate the rule-layer that carries the order—not individual behavior itself but the abstract rules actors commonly follow (prices, conventions, case law, grammar); the rules are simple while the order is complex. Third, when evaluating intervention, distinguish eliminating an unwelcome outcome from destroying the rule-system that generates it: attacking outcomes directly usually destroys the rule-system too, and it is the rule-system that reproduces the order. The key point is that the variables of complex phenomena cannot be exhausted by individual observation, so the scientific attitude toward complex order is to explain its pattern, not to predict its details.
modes.source_chapter: 《价格是通信机制》('The Use of Knowledge in Society', 1945)；《自由宪章》第三章；法与立法、自然与自发的三卷本区分 cosmos/taxis
modes.key_quote_zh: 文明的生成靠的不是设计的头脑，而是无数代人在无意中遵循并改进的规则——头脑是规则的产物，而非规则的设计者。
modes.key_quote_en: The mind does not design the rules of civilization; it is their product, formed by countless generations following and improving rules no one intended.
process_zh: 确认对象秩序属于哪一类：逐项排查是否存在真实的统一设计者与持续的最高指令，把『看起来有人设计』与『确实有人设计』分开
定位承载秩序的抽象规则层：找出行为者共同遵循的规则（价格信号、惯例、判例、协议格式），检查规则是否简单而涌现结果复杂
检验知识利用效率：估计该秩序利用了多少分散在个体手里的局部知识，与集中方案能利用的知识量对比
评估任何干预时先问它破坏的是结果还是规则系统：对结果下手是否同时摧毁了秩序的再生产机制
process_en: Confirm which kind of order you face: check whether a real unified designer and standing supreme command exist, separating 'looks designed' from 'actually designed'

Locate the abstract rule-layer carrying the order: identify the rules actors commonly follow (price signals, conventions, precedents, protocol formats) and check that the rules are simple while the emergent results are complex
Test the efficiency of knowledge use: estimate how much dispersed local knowledge the order mobilizes, compared with what any centralized scheme could mobilize
Before intervening, ask whether you are destroying an outcome or a rule-system: whether striking at results also demolishes the mechanism that reproduces the order
representative_cases_zh: 1945 年价格论文： tin 的例子——某地锡矿枯竭后，无需任何人知道原因，价格上升便让数千用户节约用锡、替代品出现，全部协调由局部知识完成
语言作为自发秩序：没有任何语言委员会设计过语法，儿童习得与日常使用让规则不断演化，任何官方规范机构都无法替代这一过程
普通法的判例演化：法官并不立法，而是在个案中发现并微调规则，千年判例累积成比任何法典编纂更适应社会的规则体系
反例警示：把『自发』误解为『放任即可』——市场秩序需要财产、契约、反欺诈等规则基础设施，哈耶克本人明确主张政府供给这些公共品；自发秩序不等于没有规则设计的问题
representative_cases_en: The 1945 tin example: when a tin mine is exhausted, nobody needs to know why; rising prices induce thousands of users to economize and substitutes to appear, all coordination carried by local knowledge
Language as spontaneous order: no language committee designed grammar; child acquisition and daily use keep the rules evolving, and no official regulator can replace that process
The evolution of case law: judges do not legislate; they discover and fine-tune rules case by case, and centuries of accumulated precedent form a rule-system more adaptive than any codification

Cautionary case: misreading 'spontaneous' as 'laissez-faire is enough'—market order requires infrastructure of property, contract, and anti-fraud rules, which Hayek explicitly assigned to government; spontaneous order is not the absence of rule-design problems
modern_applications_zh: 平台经济：出租车、外卖的路网运力靠实时价格信号自组织调度，任何中心化排班都无法处理千变万化的局部供需
开源软件生态：Linux 的演化没有总设计师，靠提交规则与许可协议这类简单规则层涌现出复杂系统
城市规划：柯布西耶式的整体重建屡屡失败，保留街道自发肌理、只修规则（土地用途、安全标准）的城市更可持续
组织管理：把创新按部门计划改为内部市场与惯例机制，让方案在局部知识竞争中涌现，管理层只设计规则不指定产品
modern_applications_en: Platform economies: ride-hailing and delivery capacity self-organizes through real-time price signals; no centralized scheduler can handle ever-shifting local supply and demand
Open-source ecosystems: Linux evolved without a master designer, emerging from simple rule-layers like commit protocols and licenses into a complex system
Urban planning: top-down rebuilds in the Corbusian style repeatedly failed; cities that preserved spontaneous street texture and regulated only rules (land use, safety) proved more sustainable

Organizational management: replace planned innovation with internal markets and convention mechanisms, letting solutions emerge from competition over local knowledge while management designs rules, not products

modes.domain_zh: 通过盘点『谁真正掌握什么知识』来判定任何集中方案的信息可行性
modes.domain_en: Judging the informational feasibility of any central scheme by inventorying who actually holds what knowledge
modes.definition_zh: 哈耶克 1945 年论文的核心贡献是把经济问题重新表述为知识利用问题：任何社会都面临一个知识总量极大、且大部分以『特定时间与地点的情势』形式分散在无数个体手里的处境——某台机器是否闲置、某人是否更擅长某项工作、某个仓库是否有余货，这些知识无法统计上报，因为它们不存在于任何人的头脑里能被完整汇总的形式中。诊断方法有三步：其一，为任何计划编制知识清单——这个方案所依赖的每一项关键判断，由谁掌握原始信息？该信息能否及时、真实地传递到决策点？其二，识别默会知识与情境知识——能被写进报告的知识只是知识总量的一小部分，大量知识以技能、直觉、就地判断的形式存在，它们随人走、随情境变，天然不可集中；其三，据此判定方案的信息可行性：若方案要求决策点掌握分散在千百处的情境知识，则无论决策者多么聪明诚实，方案在信息上不可行。这一诊断把『计划 vs 市场』之争从道德与意愿之争转换为信息结构之争——争论不再是谁更善良，而是哪一种制度能动员更多分散知识。
modes.definition_en: The core contribution of Hayek's 1945 paper is restating the economic problem as a problem of knowledge use: any society faces a body of knowledge vastly too large, most of it in the form of 'circumstances of particular times and places' dispersed among countless individuals—whether a machine sits idle, whether a person is better suited to a task, whether a warehouse holds surplus. Such knowledge cannot be statistically aggregated, because it never exists in any single mind in a form that can be fully summed up. The diagnostic has three steps. First, compile a knowledge inventory for any plan: for each key judgment the scheme depends on, who holds the original information, and can it travel to the decision point in time and intact? Second, identify tacit and situational knowledge—what can be written into reports is only a fraction; much knowledge lives as skill, intuition, and on-the-spot judgment, travels with persons, changes with situations, and is inherently uncentralizable. Third, on that basis judge informational feasibility: if a scheme requires the decision point to hold situational knowledge scattered across hundreds of places, the scheme is informationally infeasible no matter how intelligent and honest its decision-makers. This diagnosis converts the 'plan versus market' dispute from a contest of morals into a contest of information structures—no longer about who is kinder, but about which institution mobilizes more dispersed knowledge.
modes.source_chapter: 《知识在社会中的利用》('The Use of Knowledge in Society', 1945)；1974 年诺贝尔演讲《假装有知识》(The Pretence of Knowledge)
modes.key_quote_zh: 经济问题不是如何配置『给定』的资源，而是如何最好地利用这样一些知识——它们作为整体不为任何单一个人所拥有。
modes.key_quote_en: The economic problem is not how to allocate 'given' resources, but how to secure the best use of knowledge no single mind possesses as a whole.
process_zh: 为方案编制知识依赖清单：列出每项关键判断，标注其原始信息由谁持有、以何种形式存在
区分可汇总知识与不可汇总知识：能进报表的列入集中通道，只存在于技能、直觉与就地判断中的标记为天然分散
检验传递链路：评估分散知识到达决策点的时间延迟、失真率与激励扭曲（报喜不报忧、层层加码）
给出信息可行性判定：若关键知识不可及时真实地到达决策点，宣布该方案信息不可行，转向依赖局部决策的结构
process_en: Compile a knowledge-dependence inventory: list every key judgment, noting who holds the original information and in what form it exists

Separate aggregable from non-aggregable knowledge: what can enter reports goes through the central channel; what exists only as skill, intuition, and on-the-spot judgment is marked inherently dispersed
Test the transmission chain: assess delay, distortion, and incentive corruption (good-news filtering, layer-by-layer exaggeration) as dispersed knowledge travels to the decision point
Issue an informational-feasibility verdict: if the key knowledge cannot reach the decision point in time and intact, declare the scheme infeasible and shift to structures relying on local decisions
representative_cases_zh: 1930 年代社会主义计算论战：米塞斯-哈耶克一方论证，没有市场价格就无法为千万种资本品组合计算成本——中央计划局不是不想算，而是没有信息可算
苏联的计划报表失真：集体农庄虚报产量层层汇总，莫斯科根据失真数字决策，最终以粮食危机的形式暴露信息链的整体失效
wartime price control 的漏洞：管制机构能定住标价，却管不住质量下降、排队、黑市与搭配销售——被压制的价格信息以扭曲形式重新表达
反例警示：知识分散不等于集中一无是处——国防、基础科学等场景中关键知识确实可集中，哈耶克承认这类领域集中决策有效；诊断的适用边界是情境知识占主导的场景
representative_cases_en: The socialist calculation debate of the 1930s: Mises and Hayek argued that without market prices the cost of combining millions of capital goods cannot be computed—the planning board is not unwilling to calculate but has no information to calculate with
Soviet plan-report distortion: collectives inflated output figures layer by layer; Moscow decided on distorted numbers, and the failure of the whole information chain surfaced as grain crises

Loopholes in wartime price control: the agency can freeze sticker prices but cannot stop quality decay, queues, black markets, and tie-in sales—suppressed price information re-expresses itself in distorted forms

Cautionary case: dispersed knowledge does not make centralization useless—where key knowledge is genuinely centralizable (defense, basic science), Hayek conceded central decisions work; the diagnosis applies where situational knowledge dominates
modern_applications_zh: 企业数字化：老板驾驶舱只能汇总可量化指标，客户真实体验、产线老师傅的直觉仍在前线——重大决策须回到一线采样而非只看报表
疫情与灾害响应：集中指挥适合战略物资调度，但社区需要什么、哪栋楼有老人，只有基层知道——采用『集中资源+本地决策』的双层结构
AI 与数据治理：再大的模型也无法汇集员工未说出口的默会判断，组织知识管理要设计让默会知识显性化的通道
投资尽调：不迷信管理层汇报，实地盘点『谁真正掌握客户与供应链的情境知识』，据此判断总部控制力的信息边界
modern_applications_en: Corporate dashboards: an executive cockpit aggregates only quantifiables; real customer experience and veterans' intuition remain at the front line—major decisions require field sampling, not report-reading

Pandemic and disaster response: central command fits strategic-supply logistics, but only local actors know what a neighborhood needs and which building houses the elderly—adopt a two-layer structure of centralized resources and local decisions
AI and data governance: no model aggregates the tacit judgments employees never voice; knowledge management must build channels that surface tacit knowledge

Investment due diligence: distrust management presentations; audit on the ground who truly holds situational knowledge of customers and supply chains, and from that judge the informational boundary of headquarters control

modes.domain_zh: 把价格理解为压缩与传递分散信息的通信系统，并用它设计协调机制
modes.domain_en: Reading prices as a communication system that compresses and transmits dispersed information, and using it to design coordination
modes.definition_zh: 哈耶克最著名的论断是：价格体系是一台通信机器，或一种电信系统，它让无数个体只需掌握最少的信息就能采取正确的行动。价格之所以神奇，不在于它『正确反映价值』，而在于它完成了一次极端的信息压缩——全球供需的无数变化被压缩进一个数字，行为者不需要知道变化的原因（是需求上升、供给中断还是投机），只需要知道『现在贵了/便宜了』就能做出与全局相容的行动。方法上有三步：其一，把协调问题表述为信息传递问题——谁需要知道什么、多快、以什么精度；其二，设计或识别压缩机制——价格、排行、评分、指标都是把高维状态压缩成低维信号的装置，检验其压缩是否保留了行动所需的充分统计量；其三，诊断信号失真的制度根源——价格管制、垄断、补贴、外部性都会让信号偏离真实状态，矫正之道是修复信号生成机制而非替个体做决定。这一方法的深意是：与其试图让决策者无所不知，不如让信号无处不在——把智能放进机制而不是放进决策者。
modes.definition_en: Hayek's most famous claim is that the price system is a machine for communicating information, a kind of telegraph, enabling countless individuals to act correctly while knowing the minimum. Prices are marvelous not because they 'reflect true value' but because they perform an extreme compression of information—the innumerable changes of global supply and demand are compressed into one number; an actor needs to know nothing about the cause (rising demand, interrupted supply, speculation), only that 'it is dearer/cheaper now,' to act compatibly with the whole. The method has three steps. First, restate the coordination problem as an information-transmission problem—who needs to know what, how fast, at what precision. Second, design or identify the compression mechanism—prices, rankings, scores, and metrics are devices compressing high-dimensional states into low-dimensional signals; test whether the compression preserves the sufficient statistic the action requires. Third, diagnose the institutional roots of signal distortion—price controls, monopoly, subsidies, and externalities all push signals away from true states; the cure is to repair the signal-generating mechanism, not to make decisions for individuals. The deeper point: rather than trying to make decision-makers omniscient, make signals ubiquitous—put the intelligence into the mechanism, not the decision-maker.
modes.source_chapter: 《知识在社会中的利用》('The Use of Knowledge in Society', 1945)；《竞争作为一个发现程序》('Competition as a Discovery Procedure', 1968)
modes.key_quote_zh: 价格体系的奇迹在于：参与其中的人可以只知道极少的信息，却能采取与全局相容的行动。
modes.key_quote_en: The marvel of the price system is that participants can act compatibly with the whole while knowing only the barest minimum.
process_zh: 把协调问题改写为信息问题：列出每个参与者为做出正确行动所需的最小信息集
识别或设计压缩机制：寻找把全局状态压缩为低维信号的装置（价格、评分、指标），验证其是否保留行动所需的关键信息
测试信号的时间性与敏感性：信号对状态变化的响应速度与精度是否匹配决策节奏
诊断失真根源并修复机制：找到让信号偏离真实状态的制度因素，优先修复信号生成机制而不是直接指挥行为者
process_en: Restate coordination as an information problem: list the minimal information set each participant needs to act correctly

Identify or design the compression mechanism: find devices compressing global state into low-dimensional signals (prices, ratings, metrics) and verify they preserve the information the action requires
Test the signal's timing and sensitivity: whether response speed and precision match the cadence of decisions
Diagnose and repair distortion: locate the institutional factors bending signals away from true states; repair the signal-generating mechanism before commanding actors directly
representative_cases_zh: 1945 年锡的例子：锡变稀缺后，价格上涨这一单一信号让数千互不相识的用户各自节约——没有人需要知道矿为何枯竭
浮动汇率与利率：央行放弃固定汇率后，汇率本身成为贸易条件变化的实时信号，错误定价的累积得以被连续暴露而非积累到危机爆发
超市条形码与动态定价：零售业用价格尾数与货架周转数据实时传递库存信号，补货由信号驱动而非由经理判断驱动
反例警示：信号机制不是万能的——环境污染等外部性不进入价格，行为者接收的信号系统性失真；哈耶克因此支持用法律（庇古式矫正或产权界定）修复信号，而非假装信号完美
representative_cases_en: The 1945 tin example: one signal—a rising price—makes thousands of strangers economize on tin without anyone needing to know why the mine ran short

Floating exchange rates and interest rates: once fixed rates were abandoned, the exchange rate itself became a real-time signal of shifting trade conditions, exposing mispricing continuously instead of letting it accumulate to crisis
Barcodes and dynamic pricing in retail: shelves transmit inventory signals through turnover data, and restocking is driven by signals rather than managers' judgment

Cautionary case: signal mechanisms are not omnipotent—externalities like pollution never enter prices, so the signals actors receive are systematically distorted; Hayek therefore backed legal repair (Pigouvian correction or property delimitation) rather than pretending signals are perfect
modern_applications_zh: 企业内部核算：给内部服务定价（数据接口调用费、算力费），让部门像市场参与者一样根据价格信号自筹自用，替代 IT 预算的行政分配
推荐系统设计：用点击/转化信号压缩用户偏好，但要审计信号失真（标题党、刷量）并修复生成机制而非手动调权
碳定价：把环境外部性显式计入价格，让千万企业的节能决策由单一信号驱动，替代逐厂审批
团队协作工具：用看板 WIP 限制与流转速度作为『知识工作领域的价格』，让任务分配对瓶颈信号自动响应
modern_applications_en: Internal corporate accounting: price internal services (data-API calls, compute) so departments self-provision like market participants, replacing administrative IT budget allocation
Recommender design: compress user preference into click/conversion signals, but audit distortion (clickbait, fraud) and repair the generation mechanism instead of hand-tuning weights
Carbon pricing: write the environmental externality explicitly into prices so millions of firms' energy decisions are driven by one signal instead of factory-by-factory approval
Team workflow tools: use WIP limits and cycle time as 'prices of knowledge work,' letting task allocation respond automatically to bottleneck signals

modes.domain_zh: 把竞争理解为发现未知事实的程序，而非仅仅分配已知资源的机制
modes.domain_en: Understanding competition as a procedure for discovering unknown facts, not merely allocating known resources
modes.definition_zh: 主流经济学的竞赛模型预设商品、技术、需求都『已知』，竞争只是把已知资源在已知偏好间分配。哈耶克的颠覆在于：竞争的真正功能恰恰是告诉我们哪些东西存在——在没有竞争之前，更便宜的成本、更好的产品、消费者的真实偏好根本无人知晓，它们是被竞争过程发现的。方法上有三步：其一，审查『知识已被给定』的假设——凡是方案隐含『我们已知道最优解在哪里』，就要追问这些知识从何而来、由谁验证；其二，把竞争设计为发现程序——保持入场自由（任何人都可以带着新猜想进场试验）、允许失败退出、让胜出者的利润作为『发现成功的信号』而非单纯不义之财；其三，警惕用已知替代发现——规制者按当下已知的技术与需求制定标准，会系统性地锁死尚未出现的更好方案。这一方法把市场辩护从『效率配置』转换为『认知机器』：市场的价值首先在于它是人类发明的最强大的发现装置，其次才是配置效率。
modes.definition_en: Mainstream competition models presuppose that goods, technologies, and demands are 'given'; competition merely allocates known resources among known preferences. Hayek's reversal: the real function of competition is to tell us what exists—before the race is run, the cheaper cost, the better product, the consumers' true preference are unknown to anyone; they are discovered by the competitive process itself. The method has three steps. First, audit the assumption that knowledge is given: wherever a scheme implies 'we already know where the optimum lies,' ask where that knowledge came from and who verified it. Second, design competition as a discovery procedure—keep entry open (anyone may enter carrying a new conjecture), let failure exit, and treat the winner's profit as the signal of a successful discovery rather than mere ill-gotten gain. Third, guard against substituting the known for the discovered: regulators who set standards from today's known technologies and needs systematically lock out the better solutions that have not yet appeared. This shifts the defense of markets from 'efficient allocation' to 'cognitive machine': the market's value is, first, that it is the most powerful discovery device humans have built, and only second its allocative efficiency.
modes.source_chapter: 《竞争作为一个发现程序》('Competition as a Discovery Procedure', 1968)；《自由宪章》论竞争的章节
modes.key_quote_zh: 竞争作为发现程序的价值在于：只有通过它，我们才能发现尚未被人知道的这类事实——若无竞争，它们将永远不为人知或至少长期无人知晓。
modes.key_quote_en: The worth of competition as a discovery procedure: only through it do we learn facts that, without it, would remain unknown or at least long unsuspected.
process_zh: 审查知识给定假设：列出方案隐含的全部『已知项』（最优技术、真实需求、合理成本），标注每项的实际发现途径
检验发现通道是否畅通：入场是否自由、失败者能否退出、成功者能否保有其发现收益
把评价标准从『分配已知』转向『发现未知』：方案是否创造了让新猜想被试验的条件
警惕标准的发现封锁效应：任何按当前已知最优制定的标准，都要评估它是否堵死了更优方案的进入路径
process_en: Audit the knowledge-given assumption: list every 'known item' the scheme presupposes (optimal technology, true demand, reasonable cost) and note the actual route by which each was discovered
Check that the discovery channel is open: whether entry is free, losers can exit, and winners can keep the gains of their discoveries
Shift evaluation from 'allocating the known' to 'discovering the unknown': does the scheme create conditions for new conjectures to be tried?
Beware standards' discovery-blocking effect: for any standard set at today's known best, assess whether it blocks the entry of better ones
representative_cases_zh: 民用航空放松管制（美国 1978）：管制时代『已知』的票价与服务结构被打破后，枢纽-辐射网络、低成本模型等此前无人预见的方案被竞争发现
柯达与数码影像：市场既有巨头与监管者都按『已知最优』（化学胶卷）制定战略与标准，发现数码潜力的正是赛道外的入场者
哈耶克对『完全竞争』理论的批判：该理论描述的竞争状态里其实已无事可竞争——真正的竞争恰恰发生在偏离理论均衡处，新知识的进入让均衡不断被打破
反例警示：发现程序不奖励所有发现——基础科学研究很多成果无短期商业回报，哈耶克明确主张这类『发现』需要非市场资助；不能拿发现程序否定一切公共科研投入
representative_cases_en: US airline deregulation (1978): once the regulated era's 'known' fare and service structures were broken open, hub-and-spoke networks and low-cost models—unforeseen by anyone—were discovered by competition
Kodak and digital imaging: incumbents and standard-setters organized around the 'known best' (chemical film); it was entrants outside the track who discovered digital's promise

Hayek's critique of 'perfect competition' theory: in the state that theory describes there would be nothing left to compete about—real competition lives precisely in departures from theoretical equilibrium, as new knowledge keeps breaking it

Cautionary case: the discovery procedure does not reward every discovery—much basic research has no short-term commercial payoff, and Hayek explicitly held that such discovery needs non-market funding; do not invoke the procedure against all public research spending
modern_applications_zh: 内部创新赛马：同一问题放两三个团队各自拿方案，把『最优方案已知』的假设换成『让方案互相发现』，胜出方案获得追加资源
产业政策评估：补贴『当前已知最优路线』前先审查是否锁死替代路线，保留多路线并行的入场自由
招聘与竞标：不预设『理想候选人/最优供应商画像已知』，用真实试做（paid pilot）让能力被发现而非被简历陈述
产品路线图：把年度固定路线图改为持续试验组合，让用户行为发现真实需求，而非依赖年度需求调研的『已知』结论
modern_applications_en: Internal innovation racing: give the same problem to two or three teams; replace the assumption that the best solution is known with letting solutions discover each other, and add resources to winners
Industrial policy review: before subsidizing 'today's best-known route,' audit whether it locks out alternatives; keep entry open across parallel routes
Hiring and procurement: drop the assumption that the ideal candidate/vendor profile is known; use paid pilots so capability is discovered, not asserted from resumes
Product roadmaps: replace fixed annual roadmaps with a portfolio of ongoing experiments, letting user behavior discover real demand rather than trusting the 'known' conclusions of annual surveys

modes.name_zh: 知识分工与传统演化检验法
modes.domain_zh: 把传统与惯例当作存储演化知识的资产，用『何种规则幸存』来检验制度主张
modes.domain_en: Treating tradition and convention as assets storing evolved knowledge, testing institutional claims by which rules survived
modes.definition_zh: 哈耶克后期把文化演化置于方法中心：个人理性是文明演化的产物而非源头——我们继承的规则（道德、法律、货币、市场惯例）并非任何人理性的设计，而是无数代群体竞争中『谁用这套规则谁就繁荣』的筛选结果。传统因此是一种知识存储装置：它保存着没有任何当代人能完整复述的适应信息。方法上有三步：其一，把待评价的规则问『它的来源是设计还是筛选』——有漫长的幸存史且无明确作者的规则，默认携带演化信息；其二，检验规则的适应史——它在多大范围、多长时间、多少竞争性群体中被保留，幸存范围越广、信息含量越高；其三，对激进改造设置演化负担——主张废除或重写一条幸存规则的人，须证明新规则在同样范围与时间内经得起同样的竞争筛选，而非仅仅在纸面上更合乎理性。注意哈耶克的演化主义不是保守主义：他明确支持对明显不公正的具体规则逐条改造，反对的是整体理性重构。这一方法为『尊重传统』提供了非浪漫主义的理由：传统之所以值得敬重，不因为它古老，而因为它压缩了无法重做的社会实验数据。
modes.definition_en: In his later work Hayek placed cultural evolution at the center: individual reason is a product of civilizational evolution, not its source—the rules we inherit (morals, law, money, market conventions) were designed by nobody; they were sifted by competition among groups, in which those who followed them flourished. Tradition is thus a knowledge-storage device: it preserves adaptive information that no contemporary mind could restate in full. The method has three steps. First, ask of any rule whether its origin is design or selection—a rule with a long survival history and no identifiable author presumptively carries evolved information. Second, test the rule's adaptive history: across how wide a range, how long a time, and how many competing groups was it retained? The broader the survival, the higher the information content. Third, impose an evolutionary burden on radical rewrites: whoever would abolish or rewrite a surviving rule must show that the new rule would withstand the same competitive sifting over the same range and time—not merely that it looks more rational on paper. Note that Hayek's evolutionism is not conservatism: he explicitly supported item-by-item reform of clearly unjust specific rules; what he opposed was wholesale rational reconstruction. The method gives 'respect for tradition' an unromantic ground: tradition deserves regard not because it is old but because it compresses social-experiment data that cannot be rerun.
modes.source_chapter: 《致命的自负》第一章；法律、立法与自由第二卷论文化与演化的理性；1970 年演讲《知识的僭妄》相关论述
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们并非因为事情是好的才制定规则，而是我们制定了（并继承了）规则，才使得某些好的事情得以发生。
modes.key_quote_en: We did not devise rules because we saw them as good; rather, we devised—and inherited—rules that made certain good things possible.
process_zh: 为规则建立来源档案：这条规则是谁设计的？若无明确作者且幸存史漫长，默认其携带演化信息
检验幸存档案：统计规则适用的群体范围、时间跨度、竞争环境多样性，评估其信息含量
对改造方案施加演化负担：要求改造者给出新规则可承受同等竞争筛选的证据，而非纸面推演
区分逐条改造与整体重构：对具体不公保留逐条修正的通道，拒绝以整体蓝图替代演化过程
process_en: Build a provenance file for the rule: who designed it? With no identifiable author and a long survival history, presume it carries evolved information
Audit the survival record: over what range of groups, time spans, and competitive environments was the rule retained—this gauges its information content
Impose an evolutionary burden on reformers: demand evidence the new rule would survive the same competitive sifting, not a paper derivation
Separate item-by-item reform from wholesale reconstruction: keep a channel for correcting specific injustices while refusing blueprint replacements of the evolutionary process
representative_cases_zh: 货币作为演化产物：没有任何政府发明过货币，它从数千年物物交换中自发涌现，政府只是后来接管了本已存在的制度——哈耶克据此质疑货币国家主义的必然性
英美普通法 vs 法典化工程：普通法无作者、逐案演化数百年，哈耶克认为其对社会的适应信息量高于一次性理性编纂的法典
对天主教会组织延续性的研究：哈耶克晚年赞赏教会作为超千年存续的组织形式，因其规则经受了无以复加的长期筛选
反例警示：幸存不等于最优——奴隶制、种姓制也曾长期幸存；哈耶克本人区分『演化的优势』与『道德批判的空间』，幸存史只构成举证负担转移，不构成道德豁免
representative_cases_en: Money as an evolved artifact: no government invented money; it emerged from millennia of exchange, and states merely took over an institution already there—leading Hayek to question the inevitability of monetary nationalism
Anglo-American common law versus codification projects: judge-made law, authorless and evolved over centuries, held more adaptive information about society than one-shot rational codification
His late study of the Catholic Church's organizational endurance: rules that survived an unparalleled span of time carried unmatched filtering credentials

Cautionary case: survival is not optimality—slavery and caste systems also long survived; Hayek himself separated 'evolutionary advantage' from 'room for moral critique'; survival history shifts the burden of proof but grants no moral exemption
modern_applications_zh: 技术选型：评估『祖传代码/老系统』时先查它的幸存史与踩坑记录，重构前要求新架构证明能承受同等流量与故障谱系，而非仅仅代码更时髦
组织制度：改掉一条沿用多年的流程（报销、评审、排班）前，先访谈它历史上拦住过哪些真实事故，再设计替代并保留灰度回退
产品惯例与用户习惯：界面改版保留用户已演化出的使用惯例，逐项 A/B 检验替代方案，拒绝整体重设计的蓝图冲动
文化研究：把民俗、行规、社区公约当作压缩的实验数据来解码，而非当作落后的待清除物
modern_applications_en: Technology selection: before refactoring legacy systems, audit their survival history and incident record; require the new architecture to prove it can bear the same load and failure spectrum, not merely look trendier

Organizational process: before retiring a long-standing procedure (expense approval, code review, scheduling), interview which real incidents it once blocked; pilot the replacement with a rollback path
Product convention and user habit: keep conventions users have evolved, A/B-test replacements item by item, and resist the blueprint urge of full redesign
Cultural research: decode folkways, guild rules, and community covenants as compressed experimental data, not as backward objects awaiting clearance

modes.name_zh: spontaneous 排序与自由权利基础法
modes.domain_zh: 把『是否扩张可预见的个人自由领域』作为评估一切制度与政策的基线
modes.domain_en: Using whether a policy expands a foreseeable domain of personal liberty as the baseline for judging institutions
modes.definition_zh: 哈耶克对自由的定义极为技术化：自由是『一个人不受其他人任意强制的状态』，且强制必须‘可预见地’被排除——重要的不是我此刻能不能做某事，而是我能否事先知道哪些行动领域不受他人意志支配。由此他得到一个排序基线：好制度与好政策的首要检验标准，是它们是否扩大了每个人可预见的行动领域（清晰、稳定、对所有人同等适用的规则），而非它们直接承诺的结果分配。方法上有三步：其一，把任何政策改写为对行动领域的修改——它把哪些行动从他人任意意志下解放出来，又把哪些行动置于他人批准之下；其二，检验规则的『抽象性与一般性』——规则是否对未指明的对象、未预见的情况一视同仁，还是暗含对特定人群特定结果的定向处置；其三，比较强制密度——两种都能达成目标的手段，选留给个人裁量空间更大的那种。这一基线的锋利之处在于：它揭露许多『解放性』政策实为强制扩张（用一部人的批准权替代市场信号），也揭露许多『冷酷』政策实为自由扩张（取消特惠即取消一部人对另一部的支配权）。
modes.definition_en: Hayek's definition of liberty is austere and technical: liberty is the condition in which a person is not subject to coercion by the arbitrary will of another, and coercion must be foreseeably excluded—what matters is not whether I can do something now, but whether I can know in advance which areas of action lie beyond others' discretion. From this he derives an ordering baseline: the first test of any institution or policy is whether it enlarges every person's foreseeable domain of action (rules that are clear, stable, and equally applicable to all), not the distributive outcome it directly promises. The method has three steps. First, rewrite any policy as a modification of domains of action: which actions does it release from others' arbitrary will, and which does it place under others' approval? Second, test the rules' abstractness and generality: do they treat unspecified persons and unforeseen cases alike, or do they smuggle in定向 treatment of particular groups and outcomes? Third, compare coercion density: of two means that both achieve the goal, choose the one leaving larger room for individual discretion. The baseline's edge: it exposes 'liberating' policies that actually expand coercion (substituting some people's approval for market signals) and 'harsh' policies that actually expand liberty (removing a privilege removes one group's power over another).
modes.source_chapter: 《自由宪章》(The Constitution of Liberty, 1960) 第一章与导论；法律、立法与自由第二卷论法治为自由之法
modes.key_quote_zh: 自由的要义不在于我们此刻能做什么，而在于我们能否事先知道，哪些事情不取决于任何他人的批准。
modes.key_quote_en: What liberty requires is not that we can do something now, but that we can know in advance what does not depend on anyone else's approval.
process_zh: 把政策改写为行动领域变更表：列出每类行为人的处境——哪些行动获得免于他人意志的保护，哪些行动新增了审批依赖
检验规则的一般性：规则是否措辞为对一切人平等适用的抽象条件，还是对特定群体/结果的定向处置
测量强制密度：对达成同一目标的多种手段，比较各自留给个人的裁量空间与事先可预见性
给出基线排序：以『可预见自由领域的净扩张』为主指标重排方案优劣，把分配效果列为次级考虑
process_en: Rewrite the policy as a domain-of-action ledger: for each class of actors, list which actions gain protection from others' will and which acquire new approval dependencies
Test the rules' generality: are they phrased as abstract conditions equally applicable to all, or targeted treatment of specific groups and outcomes?
Measure coercion density: among means achieving the same goal, compare the discretion and foreseeability each leaves to individuals
Issue a baseline ranking: re-rank options primarily by the net expansion of foreseeable liberty, treating distributive effects as secondary
representative_cases_zh: 法治 vs 计划的对照：哈耶克论证计划当局必须区别对待具体人与具体目标，因而天然与法治（一般性规则）冲突；福利国家的某些形式（统一公民权利）与法治相容，另一些（定向恩惠）则不相容
《通往奴役之路》对战后英国的主张：不是预言灾难电影，而是论证经济控制的全盘化将使中央当局获得对个人生活前所未有的批准权
职业执照制 vs 行业认证：强制执照把进入权交给在位者委员会，自愿认证保留消费者与从业者双方的行动领域——哈耶克式分析会选后者
反例警示：自由基线不能凌驾于一切——哈耶克承认防止传染病、救急灾难等情境中强制正当；基线是默认排序，不是绝对禁令，适用时须论证例外的紧迫性
representative_cases_en: The contrast of rule of law versus planning: a planning authority must treat particular persons and goals differently, clashing with law's generality; some welfare-state forms (uniform civil rights) are compatible with it, others (targeted favor) are not

The claim of The Road to Serfdom for postwar Britain: not a disaster movie, but an argument that wholesale economic control would hand a central authority unprecedented approval power over individual lives

Occupational licensing versus voluntary certification: mandatory licensing hands entry rights to incumbent boards; voluntary certification preserves the action-domains of both consumers and practitioners—a Hayekian analysis picks the latter

Cautionary case: the liberty baseline is not supreme—Hayek conceded coercion is justified against epidemics and disasters; the baseline is a default ranking, not an absolute ban, and exceptions require arguing their urgency
modern_applications_zh: 平台规则治理：评审新功能时先做『行动领域变更表』——这个功能把用户的哪些自主操作变成需平台审批？默认选保留用户可预见性的方案
企业合规设计：把合规要求写为一般性抽象规则（红线清单）而非逐案审批制，让员工可预见边界并自主行动
教育政策辩论：评估任何『为子女好』的强制安排时，比较其相对替代方案的强制密度与儿童可预见空间
个人决策：签合同、接受岗位前先问『哪些行动从此需要对方批准』，用强制密度而非头衔薪酬比较 offer
modern_applications_en: Platform rule governance: for every new feature, draft a domain-of-action ledger—which user operations does it turn into platform approvals? Default to the option preserving user foreseeability
Corporate compliance design: write requirements as general abstract rules (red-line lists) rather than case-by-case approvals, letting employees foresee boundaries and act autonomously
Education policy debates: when judging any 'for the children's good' compulsion, compare its coercion density and the child's foreseeable space against alternatives
Personal decisions: before signing a contract or accepting a role, ask 'which of my actions will henceforth require their approval,' comparing offers by coercion density rather than title and salary

modes.domain_zh: 系统性检测『知识僭妄』——决策者对自己知识完备性的过高估计
modes.domain_en: Systematically testing for 'the pretence of knowledge'—decision-makers' overestimate of the completeness of their own knowledge
modes.definition_zh: 哈耶克 1974 年诺贝尔演讲的警告是：经济学误用了自然科学的方法——自然科学的成功在于能找到变量的精确规律并量化预测，而社会领域的变量（人类行为的信念、预期、知识）本质上不可精确测量，硬套量化方法会制造『科学-looking』的虚假精确。致命自负的典型症状是：决策者把『可以测量』等同于『是重要的』，把『模型可计算』等同于『现实可控制』。检验方法有三步：其一，审计测量边界——列出决策所依据的全部量化指标，逐项追问：这个指标遗漏了什么不可测量的重要变量？其二，审计预测声明——凡是给出点预测的方案，检查其历史校准率（过去的预测兑现率）而非逻辑美感；其三，检测控制幻觉——方案是否假设『实施后系统会按模型运行』，并为模型失效预设了退出与修正通道。这一方法的日常形态是：对任何表现得笃定的大计划，先问『决策者的知识从哪里来，有没有人验证过』——自负不是智力缺陷而是知识结构缺陷，最聪明的人最有资格犯它。
modes.definition_en: The warning of Hayek's 1974 Nobel lecture: economics misused the method of natural science—the success of physics lies in finding precise laws and quantified predictions, but social variables (beliefs, expectations, knowledge of human action) are in principle unmeasurable with precision; forcing quantitative method onto them manufactures pseudo-precise 'science-looking' results. The classic symptom of the fatal conceit: decision-makers equate 'measurable' with 'important' and 'computable in the model' with 'controllable in reality.' The test has three steps. First, audit the measurement boundary: list every quantitative indicator the decision rests on and ask, for each, what important but unmeasurable variables it omits. Second, audit prediction claims: for any plan offering point forecasts, examine its historical calibration—the hit rate of past forecasts—rather than its logical elegance. Third, detect the control illusion: does the plan assume 'once implemented, the system will run as the model says,' and has it preset exit and correction channels for model failure? In daily form: for any grand plan delivered with confidence, first ask 'where does the decision-maker's knowledge come from, and has anyone verified it'—the conceit is not an intellectual defect but a structural defect of knowledge, and the cleverest are best qualified to commit it.
modes.source_chapter: 1974 年诺贝尔演讲《假装有知识》(The Pretence of Knowledge)；《致命的自负》(The Fatal Conceit, 1988)
modes.key_quote_zh: 当人意识到自己的理性不足以驾驭复杂社会时，他才开始变得真正明智——承认无知是智慧的开端。
modes.key_quote_en: One becomes truly wise upon realizing that one's reason cannot master complex society—the recognition of ignorance is the beginning of wisdom.
process_zh: 审计测量边界：为决策所依赖的每个量化指标列出其遗漏的重要不可测变量，标注『指标盲区』
审计预测校准：调取该决策者/模型过去同类预测的兑现记录，按命中率而非逻辑优美度评分
检测控制幻觉：检查方案是否假定系统会按模型运行，是否预设了失效退出与在线修正通道
输出谦逊化改造：把点预测改为区间与情景，把单一方案改为可试验组合，把『确定执行』改为『条件执行』
process_en: Audit the measurement boundary: for each quantitative indicator the decision rests on, list the important unmeasurables it omits—mark the 'metric blind spots'
Audit prediction calibration: pull the decision-maker's or model's track record on similar forecasts, scoring by hit rate rather than elegance
Detect the control illusion: check whether the plan assumes the system will run as modeled and whether exit and online-correction channels are preset
Output a humility retrofit: turn point forecasts into ranges and scenarios, single plans into trial portfolios, and 'certain execution' into 'conditional execution'
representative_cases_zh: 1970 年代通胀-失业权衡的破产：按菲利普斯曲线模型操作的货币当局承诺用通胀换就业，结果滞胀同时出现——模型变量漏掉了预期，而预期不可精确测量
苏联五年计划的统计悖论：官方统计越精细，决策离真实越远——可测量的（吨位、工时）被最大化，不可测量的（质量、品种适配）被牺牲
哈耶克对『社会工程』知识论的批判：兰格等市场社会主义者承认信息问题却假设『可以仿真市场』，哈耶克指出仿真本身就需要本来就不存在的那种完备知识
反例警示：反自负不等于反量化——哈耶克反对的是把不可测者伪装成已测者，对真正可测且稳定的对象（工程容差、流行病学基础量）量化决策完全正当；检验的关键是测量边界是否与对象性质匹配
representative_cases_en: The bankruptcy of the 1970s inflation-unemployment trade-off: monetary authorities running Phillips-curve models promised inflation in exchange for jobs, and got stagflation—the model omitted expectations, which cannot be measured precisely

The statistical paradox of Soviet five-year plans: the finer official statistics, the further decisions drifted from reality—the measurable (tonnage, man-hours) was maximized while the unmeasurable (quality, assortment fit) was sacrificed

Hayek's epistemic critique of 'social engineering': market socialists like Lange conceded the information problem but assumed the market 'could be simulated'; Hayek replied that the simulation itself requires the very complete knowledge that does not exist

Cautionary case: anti-conceit is not anti-quantification—Hayek opposed disguising the unmeasurable as measured; for genuinely measurable, stable objects (engineering tolerances, epidemiological base rates), quantitative decisions are fully legitimate; the key is whether the measurement boundary matches the object's nature
modern_applications_zh: 战略规划审计：每年对全公司 KPI 做一次『盲区清单』——哪些关键现实（士气、品牌损伤、竞品暗动作）没有任何指标覆盖
AI 模型上线治理：强制提交历史校准报告与失效场景预案，拒绝只有内部验证集指标的『确定性』模型进入生产
大型项目评审：对承诺『按期按预算』的超级工程，核对主办方历史兑现率并要求分阶段 go/no-go 闸门
个人判断卫生：对自己高置信度的判断记录预测与期限，到期复盘——用个人校准率代替自信感
modern_applications_en: Strategic-planning audit: run an annual 'blind-spot inventory' of company KPIs—which critical realities (morale, brand damage, competitors' quiet moves) no metric covers
AI model launch governance: require historical calibration reports and failure-scenario plans; keep 'certain' models with only internal-validation metrics out of production
Mega-project review: for promises of on-time, on-budget delivery, check the sponsor's historical hit rate and require stage gates with go/no-go
Personal judgment hygiene: log your high-confidence predictions with deadlines and review them when due—replace the feeling of confidence with a personal calibration rate

modes.name_zh: 货币非国家化竞争发行法
modes.domain_zh: 用竞争结构替代垄断结构来供给原本由垄断者提供的制度品（货币、法律、信用）
modes.domain_en: Replacing monopoly with competitive structure in supplying institution-goods once monopolized (money, law, credit)
modes.definition_zh: 1976 年哈耶克提出其最具争议的主张：既然我们从未论证过货币为何必须由政府垄断发行，就应当让私人机构发行相互竞争的货币，用竞争的纪律替代中央银行的 discretion。其方法论价值大于具体政策价值：它展示了一类通用思考——每当一个制度品由垄断者供给且质量可疑时，不要先争论『如何改进垄断者』，而要问『这个东西是否可以竞争性供给』。方法上有三步：其一，识别供给结构——该制度品（货币、征信、身份认证、争端解决）目前由谁排他供给，其垄断地位来自效率还是来自立法特权；其二，设计竞争准入——若放开供给，新进入者的纪律机制是什么（兑付竞争、声誉竞争、迁移成本），垄断者曾经免费获得的『信任租金』将被竞争压缩；其三，处理网络外部性——货币、标准这类品有强者恒强的锁定效应，竞争设计须回答冷启动问题（并行记账、可兑换承诺、锚定既有价值）。这一方法近年已被现实部分验证：加密货币、稳定币、私人支付网络就是货币竞争发行的部分实现。
modes.definition_en: In 1976 Hayek made his most controversial proposal: since nobody ever demonstrated why money must be a government monopoly, private institutions should issue competing currencies, subjecting money to the discipline of competition instead of the discretion of a central bank. Its methodological value exceeds its policy value: it demonstrates a general move—whenever an institution-good is supplied by a monopolist with questionable quality, do not first debate 'how to improve the monopolist'; ask 'can this good be competitively supplied?' Three steps. First, identify the supply structure: who exclusively supplies the institution-good (money, credit scoring, identity, dispute resolution), and does the monopoly rest on efficiency or legislative privilege? Second, design competitive access: if supply were opened, what disciplines entrants (redemption competition, reputational competition, switching costs)? The 'trust rents' the monopolist collected for free would be competed away. Third, handle network externalities: money and standards exhibit winner-take-all lock-in, so the competitive design must answer the cold-start problem (parallel bookkeeping, redemption promises, anchoring to existing value). Reality has partially vindicated the method: cryptocurrencies, stablecoins, and private payment networks are partial realizations of competitive issuance.
modes.source_chapter: 《货币的非国家化》(Denationalisation of Money, 1976)；《自由宪章》论货币的章节；晚年关于两种货币的访谈
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不主张废除政府，我主张把政府从它从未证明自己有资格垄断的领域里请出去。
modes.key_quote_en: I do not propose abolishing government; I propose asking government to leave the domain it never proved entitled to monopolize.
process_zh: 绘制供给结构图：该制度品由谁排他供给？垄断地位的法律来源与效率来源分别是什么
设计竞争纪律：放开后新供给者靠什么约束自己（兑付、声誉、可迁移性），用户用什么惩罚劣质供给者
解决冷启动与锁定：为网络外部性品设计并行期机制——可兑换承诺、锚定、迁移补贴，避免『劣币在位者』靠体量续命
评估监管最小内核：识别竞争无法供给的公共品部分（反欺诈、破产清算），把政府角色收缩到这个内核
process_en: Map the supply structure: who exclusively supplies the institution-good, and is the monopoly grounded in law or in efficiency?
Design competitive discipline: after opening, what binds new suppliers (redemption, reputation, portability), and how do users punish bad suppliers?
Solve cold start and lock-in: for network-externality goods, build parallel-period mechanisms—redemption promises, anchoring, migration subsidies—so the incumbent cannot survive on scale alone
Define the minimal regulatory core: identify what competition cannot supply (anti-fraud, bankruptcy resolution) and contract the state's role to that core
representative_cases_zh: 1976 年货币非国家化：哈耶克论证各国通胀的根源是垄断发钞不受纪律约束——若汇丰、劳埃德各自发钞，滥发者会被用户抛弃，货币像商品一样接受质量竞争
加密稳定币的兴起：私人发行、锚定法币、可实时赎回的代币在十年内长成数千亿美元市场——垄断发行在技术上已被绕开，同时也验证了竞争带来的欺诈风险（算法稳定币崩溃）
私营征信与支付网络：Visa/万事达把跨境清算从国家专营变成卡组织竞争，费率与到账时间被竞争压优
反例警示：竞争发行不消除系统性风险——2008 年货币市场基金挤兑、2022 年稳定币脱锚都显示私人货币同样恐慌传染；哈耶克方案的弱点在最后贷款人缺位，竞争结构需与危机处置机制配套
representative_cases_en: Denationalisation of Money (1976): Hayek traced chronic inflation to the undisciplined issuance monopoly—were HSBC and Lloyds each issuing money, over-issuers would be abandoned by users and money would face quality competition like any commodity

The rise of stablecoins: privately issued, fiat-anchored, instantly redeemable tokens grew into a market of hundreds of billions within a decade—technical bypass of the issuance monopoly, while also validating competition's fraud risks (the algorithmic-stablecoin collapses)
Private credit and payment networks: Visa and Mastercard turned cross-border clearing from state franchise into network competition, optimizing fees and settlement times

Cautionary case: competitive issuance does not abolish systemic risk—the 2008 money-market-fund runs and 2022 stablecoin depegs show private money is equally subject to contagion; the plan's weakness is the missing lender of last resort, so competitive structure needs a crisis-resolution counterpart
modern_applications_zh: 企业内部工具选型：对被单一供应商垄断的内部制度品（身份认证、审批系统），设计双供应商并行与数据可迁移条款，让『换用成本』成为供应商纪律
行业基础设施开放：评估本行业哪些『天然垄断』环节（清算、认证、评级）实为历史立法特权，推动竞争性供给试点
AI 模型采购：不让单一模型方垄断关键业务能力，保持双模型并行与提示词/数据资产可迁移，用切换成本约束供应商
社区货币与积分设计：地方消费券、企业积分可借鉴竞争发行纪律——承诺兑付、公开储备、允许第三方市场交易
modern_applications_en: Internal tooling selection: for institution-goods monopolized by one vendor (identity, approval systems), design dual-supplier parallelism and data-portability clauses so switching cost disciplines the vendor
Opening industry infrastructure: audit which 'natural monopoly' layers (clearing, certification, ratings) are really historical legislative privileges, and pilot competitive supply
AI model procurement: never let one model vendor monopolize a critical capability; keep dual models with portable prompts and data assets, constraining vendors through switching costs
Community currency and points design: borrow issuance discipline for vouchers and loyalty points—redemption promises, public reserves, third-party market tradability

modes.domain_zh: 用『情境逻辑』重构历史人物的决策处境，生成可迁移的判例库
modes.domain_en: Reconstructing a historical actor's situation with 'situational logic' to generate transferable case libraries
modes.definition_zh: 哈耶克的方法论深受波普尔『情境逻辑』影响：解释一个人的行动，不必猜测其内心，而应重构其所处情境——给定他掌握的信息、面对的约束、可用的选项，看一个理性人在此情境下会如何行动；若历史人物的实际行动与重构一致，解释成立。这是把历史变成『决策案例库』的方法：每个历史情境都是一次受控的决策实验，其约束条件记录完整，可供后人代入练习。方法上有三步：其一，列出情境要素——决策者的信息集（他知道什么、误信什么）、硬约束（资源、法律、时间）、激励结构（成败各得失什么）；其二，推演理性选项空间——在要素给定下枚举可行策略，标注每种的预期结果；其三，对照史实校准——比较实际选择与推演，偏离处即说明有未列出的要素（隐藏信息、非理性偏好、第三方介入），把它们补入案例。这样生成的案例既不是道德故事也不是成功学，而是带完整约束标注的决策题——训练者面对的不是『他做了什么』而是『换成你在同样信息与约束下怎么办』。
modes.definition_en: Hayek's methodology was shaped by Popper's 'situational logic': to explain an action, do not guess at the actor's mind—reconstruct the situation. Given the information held, the constraints faced, and the options available, infer how a rational person would act; if the historical actor's actual action matches the reconstruction, the explanation stands. This turns history into a library of decision cases: each historical situation is a controlled decision experiment whose constraints are fully recorded and open for later practitioners to inhabit. Three steps. First, list the situational elements: the decider's information set (what he knew, what he mistakenly believed), hard constraints (resources, law, time), and incentive structure (gains and losses of success and failure). Second, derive the rational option space: enumerate feasible strategies given the elements, annotating each one's expected outcome. Third, calibrate against the record: compare the actual choice with the derivation; divergences indicate unlisted elements (hidden information, irrational preferences, third-party intervention), which are then folded into the case. The cases so generated are neither moral tales nor success manuals but decision problems with complete constraint annotations—training on 'what would you do with the same information and constraints,' not 'what did he do.'
modes.source_chapter: 哈耶克《科学的反革命》中对方法论个人主义与情境分析的论述；波普尔《历史决定论的贫困》第四章情境逻辑
modes.key_quote_zh: 解释社会现象的正确路径不是进入他人心中，而是重建他人所处的情境——在同样情境下，你也会那样行动。
modes.key_quote_en: The right path to explaining social phenomena is not entering another's mind but rebuilding his situation—in the same situation, you would have acted likewise.
process_zh: 建立情境档案：为案例人物列出信息集（已知/误信/未知）、硬约束、激励得失三张清单
推演选项空间：在档案给定下枚举理性可选策略，为每个策略标注当时可预期的结果分布
校准史实偏离：对比实际选择与推演结果，把偏离归因于未列要素并补入档案
生成可代入判例：把完整情境档案与选项分析写成决策题，让学习者先自行决策再对照史实
process_en: Build the situation file: three lists for the case's actor—information (known/misbelieved/unknown), hard constraints, incentive gains and losses
Derive the option space: given the file, enumerate rational strategies and annotate each with its then-expected outcome distribution
Calibrate divergence from the record: attribute any gap between actual choice and derivation to missing elements and fold them back into the file
Generate an inhabitable case: write the full situation file and option analysis as a decision problem—learners decide first, then compare with history
representative_cases_zh: 哈耶克 1931 年就职演讲对大萧条的预判：情境档案是——金本位约束、央行知识（货币总量可控但机制未知）、政治激励（避免通缩指责）；他推演『维持宽松将把萧条拖长』，与凯恩斯同题异解，构成教科书级的双解对照案例
社会主义计算论战的情境重构：双方在 1920-1940 年的信息集（尚无计算机、统计能力有限）下各自推演，后来的分布式计算与拍卖算法部分改写了情境要素——案例演示了『情境变更则结论可修订』
货币竞争提案（1976）：哈耶克把 1970 年代滞胀（情境：法币通胀、汇兑管制、通信成本高）作为约束清单推演私人发钞可行性，其『通信成本』要素在互联网后被移除——判例自动标记为『情境已变，需重推』
反例警示：情境逻辑不承认事后诸葛——用事后信息填入历史人物的信息集，推演就变成道德审判；生成案例时须严格执行『只用当时可知信息』的纪律
representative_cases_en: Hayek's 1931 inaugural lecture on the Depression: the situation file—gold-standard constraint, central-bank knowledge (money stock controllable but mechanism unknown), political incentives (blame for deflation); his derivation 'loose money prolongs the slump' against Keynes's rival solution on the same file forms a textbook paired-derivation case

Reconstructing the socialist-calculation debate: both sides derived from 1920s-40s information sets (no computers, limited statistics); later distributed computing and auction algorithms partly rewrote the situational elements—the case demonstrates 'change the situation and the conclusion may be revised'

The competitive-currency proposal (1976): Hayek derived private issuance from 1970s constraints (fiat inflation, exchange controls, high communication costs); the internet later removed the communication-cost element—such cases are auto-flagged 'situation changed, re-derive required'

Cautionary case: situational logic forbids hindsight—filling a historical actor's information set with post-hoc knowledge turns derivation into moral judgment; case generation must enforce the 'only what was knowable then' discipline
modern_applications_zh: 商业复盘课程：把公司历史重大决策（进入/退出市场、并购）做成情境档案判例，新管理者先在档案内推演再对照实际结果
决策训练平台：AI 面试官按情境逻辑出题——给定信息集与约束让候选人推演选项，评分其选项空间完备性而非答案对错
历史研究教学：把『评人物』改为『重建情境』，学生作业是提交信息集/约束/激励三清单与选项空间图
个人复盘模板：每个重大决策后自建三张清单，标注当时未知要素，半年后回看哪些要素变化支持了或推翻了原决策
modern_applications_en: Business postmortem courses: turn major company decisions (market entry/exit, M&A) into situation-file cases; new managers derive inside the file before seeing outcomes

Decision-training platforms: an AI interviewer poses situational-logic problems—given an information set and constraints, the candidate derives options and is scored on the completeness of the option space, not the answer
Teaching historical research: replace 'judging figures' with 'rebuilding situations'; students submit the three lists and an option-space map
A personal retrospective template: after every major decision, build the three lists, mark the then-unknowns, and revisit half a year later to see which elements changed for or against the decision

modes.domain_zh: 以数十年跨学科积累为基础，分层递进地交付一个完整理论体系
modes.domain_en: Delivering a complete theoretical system in layered stages on the basis of decades of cross-disciplinary accumulation
modes.definition_zh: 哈耶克的学术生命是一个罕见的交付样本：从 1920 年代心理学（《感觉的秩序》提出心智分类理论）到 1940 年代经济学（知识问题）到 1960-70 年代政治哲学与法理学（《自由宪章》、法与立法）再到 1988 年《致命的自负》总结，他用六十年把一个核心洞察（复杂秩序不可设计）逐层展开到学科全域。方法上有三步：其一，确立『内核问题』早于学科选择——哈耶克 20 岁前后形成的对『心智如何组织感觉』的追问，本质上就是后来全部工作的内核（复杂系统的分类不可能被系统自身完全复述）；其二，跨学科迂回而非单科深钻——每个学科（心理学、经济学、法学、政治哲学）他都只取其对该内核问题的透射，完成一层后迁往下一层，不追求单学科内的博士式完备；其三，总结性交付放最后——把全部学科层用一个统一概念（演化、自发秩序）收束成单卷本，此时读者获得的是六十年压缩。对个人治学的启示：与其在每个热点上浅尝，不如锁定一个终生问题，让学科为问题服务而非相反。
modes.definition_en: Hayek's scholarly life is a rare delivery specimen: from 1920s psychology (The Sensory Order's theory of mental classification) through 1940s economics (the knowledge problem) to 1960s-70s political philosophy and jurisprudence (The Constitution of Liberty, Law, Legislation and Liberty) and the 1988 summation The Fatal Conceit, he spent sixty years unfolding one core insight—complex order cannot be designed—layer by layer across whole disciplines. The method has three steps. First, fix the kernel question before choosing disciplines: the question about how the mind classifies sensations that Hayek formed around age twenty is the kernel of all later work (a complex system cannot fully restate its own classification). Second, interdisciplinary detour rather than single-discipline depth: in each field (psychology, economics, law, political philosophy) he took only that field's projection of the kernel question, moved to the next layer when done, and never pursued doctoral completeness within one discipline. Third, deliver the synthesis last: bind all disciplinary layers into one volume under a unifying concept (evolution, spontaneous order); readers then receive sixty years compressed. For personal scholarship: rather than sampling every hot topic, lock onto one lifelong question and let disciplines serve the question, not the reverse.
modes.source_chapter: 《感觉的秩序》(The Sensory Order, 1952，但其核心形成于 1919-1920)；《致命的自负》(1988)；1974 年诺贝尔演讲的自我定位
modes.key_quote_zh: 一个人四十年只回答一个问题，胜过四十年回答四十个问题——问题的深度决定答案的寿命。
modes.key_quote_en: Forty years spent answering one question outweighs forty years answering forty—the depth of the question decides the lifespan of the answer.
process_zh: 确立内核问题：用一句话陈述你要用一生回答的问题，检查它是否足够深（能投射到多个学科）且足够稳定（十年后仍成立）
规划学科透射序列：列出该问题在各学科的透射面，按『工具依赖顺序』排列（先取数据与逻辑工具，后取规范与综合工具）
每层只交付该层最小完备：在每个学科内完成『对本问题必要的最小体系』即迁移，抵抗单科完备性的诱惑
设计总结性收束：为全部层预备一个统一概念，在积累成熟时用单卷本/长文完成体系化，让晚成成为复利而非拖延
process_en: State in one sentence the question you will spend your life on; check it is deep enough to project across disciplines and stable enough to hold in ten years
Plan the sequence of disciplinary projections: list the question's projection surface in each field, ordered by tool dependency (data and logic tools first, normative and synthetic tools later)
Deliver each layer's minimal completeness: within each discipline finish only the minimal system the question requires, then migrate—resist the temptation of disciplinary completeness
Design the final synthesis: prepare one unifying concept for all layers and, when accumulation matures, systematize in a single volume or long essay, so lateness compounds rather than procrastinates
representative_cases_zh: 哈耶克《感觉的秩序》的幽灵地位：该书 1952 年出版后几乎无人引用，但哈耶克自述其全部社会理论都是该书心智论的推论——内核先行，交付可以迟到三十年
从技术经济学到法理学的迁回：哈耶克在《价格与生产》声望顶点（1930 年代）主动转战知识论与政治哲学，承受『过气』代价——每层交付完成即迁移的纪律
《法、立法与自由》三卷本（1973-79）：以近八十岁完成法理学体系，把此前四十年各层成果收束进演化法理学
反例警示：内核锁定不等于拒绝修正——哈耶克早年商业周期理论与后来的货币竞争主张并不完全一致，他允许内核（不可设计性）稳定而外围结论随情境更新；终生问题应容忍外围结论的迭代
representative_cases_en: The spectral status of The Sensory Order: barely cited after 1952, yet Hayek said all his social theory was corollary of its theory of mind—kernel first, delivery may lag thirty years

The detour from technical economics to jurisprudence: at the peak of his fame (1930s) he switched to epistemology and political philosophy, paying an 'has-been' price—the discipline of migrating once a layer is delivered
Law, Legislation and Liberty (1973-79): a jurisprudential system finished near age eighty, binding four decades of results into evolutionary jurisprudence

Cautionary case: kernel lock-in is not refusal to revise—early business-cycle theory and later currency competition do not fully agree; Hayek kept the kernel (undesignability) stable while updating peripheral conclusions with the situation; a lifelong question must tolerate peripheral iteration
modern_applications_zh: 个人知识管理：为 10 年以上研究问题建立『学科透射地图』，每读一个领域先问它对本问题的透射面是什么，防精力漂散
职业生涯规划：把『转行』重新定义为『内核问题的下一层迁回』——换学科不换问题，让履历成为体系而非碎片
内容创作策略：先写小层交付（博客、论文）积累各层，预留最终综合写作位（书/长文），避免一开始就写综合导致空洞
组织研发战略：给基础研究团队锁定 5-10 年问题，允许其跨学科取工具，考核按『层交付』而非年度 KPI
modern_applications_en: Personal knowledge management: build a 'disciplinary projection map' for any 10-year-plus research question; before reading any field ask what it projects onto the question, to stop energy drift
Career planning: redefine 'changing fields' as 'the next detour of the kernel question'—change disciplines, not the question, so a resume becomes a system rather than fragments
Content strategy: deliver small layers first (essays, papers), reserving a final synthesis slot (book or long essay); writing the synthesis first leaves it hollow
Organizational R&D strategy: lock basic-research teams onto 5-10-year questions, let them borrow tools across disciplines, and appraise by layer delivery rather than annual KPI
